notes.title: Minor QOL Update #5
notes.notes:
Added extra lights in certain level involving dolls
 Added extra hints to easily notice the hidden world's elevator screen
 Added a way to prevent the player getting lost in certain level involving tunnels
 Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the player to access the easter egg level if certain conditions were not met.
 Fixed a language bug after selecting Korean as language

notes.title: Alternate Endings Hints Update
notes.notes:
Added a new hint for an ending inside Father's level.
 Added a new hint behind the sailor's game rules.
 Added a new secret ending.
 Fixed the easter egg level's enemy behaviour
 Minor bug fixes
 Minor QOL fixes in many levels (fixed glitched shadows, rebalanced sprint time, fixed colliders)

notes.title: Minor QOL Update #4
notes.notes:
Added a button to hide the relic (By default R and CTRL).
 Fixed a bug which made certain doll to teleport randomly.
 Minor changes to Father level.
 Added an easter egg in one of the levels that use the relic.


A relatively big update is coming soon, which will help the player find the two extra endings.

notes.title: Minor QOL Update #3
notes.notes:
Fixed a major bug that caused the game to skip a large portion of the levels when dying in certain level.
 Fixed a graphical issue at the end of the mall level.
 Added a subtle light hint in certain level with pressure plates to facilitate understanding the layout of a room.
 Minor changes in some levels.

notes.title: Minor QOL Update #2
notes.notes:
Added a subtle hint to Father's location.
 Fixed a bug in Father's level where the player would get smaller each time they went to sleep.
 Fixed a way to cheese Father's level (using Miraculousfalcon's strategy)
 Added a hint to remind the player about the flashlight in certain level.
 Added an extra light to help the player prevent a sudden death in certain level.
 Added minor changes to some levels.

notes.title: Minor QOL Update #1
notes.notes:
Added a light at the end of certain level to visualize the level's objective.
Rebalanced the difficulty of Father's level.
Added checkpoints in certain level with sliding metal gates.
Fixed minor bugs in previous levels.

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that prevented Korean credits from appearing

notes.title: Augurium Hotfix #1
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that would prevent the player from accessing the 'Secret Menu' after beating the game

notes.title: 1.02 Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Fixed a problem with the Sailor's pathfinding.
- Added hint in certain level.
- Rebalanced sprint duration in new levels.

notes.title: Update 1.01 Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Rebalanced sprint time in various levels
- Fixed minor bugs
